rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is new to an activity or subject.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 hok6 zyu2 sung3 ge3 san1 sau2

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing someone who is just beginning to learn a subject or skill.

example.english: This book is perfect for a beginner.
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 ngaam1 saai3 co1 hok6 ze2

rows.note: Use this colloquial term for a novice, often with a self-deprecating or informal tone.

example.english: I'm a beginner at badminton, so please give me lots of advice.
example.traditional: 我係打羽毛球嘅初哥，請大家多多指教。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 daa2 jyu5 mou4 kau4 ge3 co1 go1 cing2 daai6 gaa1 do1 do1 zi2 gaau3
